name: Should I buy a vacant lot or an existing home for renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I buy a vacant lot or an existing home for renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to buy a vacant lot or an existing home for renovation depends on your priorities. A vacant lot offers complete design freedom, allowing you to create a home perfectly tailored to your lifestyle without compromising on layout or features. However, it involves a longer timeline and typically higher upfront planning costs. Renovating an existing home can be quicker and potentially less expensive, but you are constrained by the original structure and may encounter unforeseen issues. Consider your budget, desired customization, and patience for the construction process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a vacant lot for complete design freedom and a custom build, or an existing home for potentially quicker, less costly renovation with structural constraints.
